text:
```yaml
name: Setup Zig Pin Policy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check-setup-zig-pin:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify mlugg/setup-zig is pinned
        run: |
          echo "Checking for unpinned mlugg/setup-zig usage..."
          if grep -R "uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2" .github/workflows/*.yml; then
            echo "Error: Found unpinned mlugg/setup-zig@v2 usage. Please pin to the immutable SHA."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No unpinned mlugg/setup-zig@v2 usage found."
          fi
```
